name: archive_pair_state_and_clear
description: When the list count exceeds three and a pairing flag is clear, copies the entry's fields and its partner's fields into a fixed archive area, clears both entries' pointers and sets a timer global to ten. Otherwise it points the entry at a global and records state twenty-eight.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E5E8
name: point_entry_set_state_28
description: Points an entry at a global structure and records state twenty-eight.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E5FC
name: clear_pair_flags_and_state
description: Sets a counter global to three, clears a flag in the entry and in its partner, points the entry at a global, and records state twenty-nine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E624
name: advance_pair_sequence_counter
description: When the list count is below thirteen, updates a sequence counter from the entry and partner positions and resets it when the sequence passes four. It sets a flag and records state thirty.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E684
name: clear_flag_and_point_entry
description: Clears a flag, points the entry at a global structure, and records the state value passed in.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E6B2
name: increment_counter_and_set_state
description: Increments a global counter, records the state value passed in, and installs the handler pointer.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E6BE
name: increment_second_counter_set_state
description: Increments a second global counter, records the state value passed in, and installs the handler pointer.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E75A
name: clear_entry_motion_or_dispatch
description: When its byte argument is non-zero it clears the entry's motion fields and its pointer. Otherwise it dispatches on the entry's type byte to the shared state cases; the listing is truncated, so later cases are not described.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E770
name: reset_timer_and_dispatch_state
description: Clears the entry's timer and dispatches on its type byte to the shared state cases, where case nineteen sets a flag; the listing is truncated, so later cases are not described.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E790
name: update_tile_layer_bytes
description: Walks a list of table records, stepping a byte value up or down by one depending on a flag, and writes its low two bits into each cell of a run. Each cell is spaced twenty-four bytes apart and is marked with a constant one.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E7F8
name: repeat_routine_and_set_flags
description: Calls one routine twenty-two times, then sets one global flag to one and clears another to zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E868
name: run_alternating_phase_routines
description: Alternates between two sets of routine calls on each run, making thirteen calls in one phase and nine in the other, with an extra call when a global is set. It then toggles the phase flag and makes one more call.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E902
name: reset_entity_flags_and_counters
description: Resets three counters and clears a flag byte in each of twelve table entries. When a count global is non-zero, it sets two entry flags according to bits returned by other routines.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E984
name: remap_table_entries_by_routine
description: When a global flag is clear, walks a table of words until a terminator, replacing each entry with the result of a routine applied to its high word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:E9D0
name: propagate_cyclic_offset_chain
description: Walks two groups of five linked entries, deriving a cyclic byte value from a neighbour's field by adding or subtracting one with wrap at ten. It writes that value with a flag into each entry.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:EA18
name: store_call_result_with_constant
description: Calls a routine with the constant 624 and stores its returned value in a global variable.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:EA36
name: update_entry_from_cycling_index
description: Advances a four-bit counter, reads a table byte at half the counter's value, stores that byte in an entry's field eleven and sets the entry's flag.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:EA6E
name: initialize_state_from_routine_queries
description: Resets several global counters and sets a flag from a bit of one routine's result. It sets two structure state bytes from other results, and when a count global is zero it sets them to fixed values.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:EB0E
name: update_cycling_state_values
description: Advances several cycling state bytes with wrap-around, updates a counter by an offset taken from a state byte and clamps it to the range zero to 511. It also writes table values into a status byte and clears some flags.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:ECB4
name: reset_sequence_and_set_flags
description: Calls a routine, clears two counters, and sets two flags to one. It then sets a structure state byte from a bit of another routine's result, or to four when a count is zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:ED1E
name: spawn_into_free_slot
description: Cycles state bytes on each step while a flag is set and counts a timer down, and when the timer expires it toggles a side. If that side has a pending request it initialises the first free entry of a 40-entry table with values chosen by side and a shared state, otherwise it counts an active entry's state down.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:EEC0
name: reset_game_state_flags
description: Calls a routine, then sets two global flags to one, a countdown to 1250, and a second counter to ten. It also clears a byte field in each of two structures and zeroes another counter.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:EF0E
name: update_cycling_flags_on_countdown
description: When a countdown global is zero, clears several state bytes and a flag. Otherwise it decrements the countdown, toggles one state byte at an interval derived from the countdown, cycles counters with wrap-around, and ends by combining a flag with another.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F056
name: copy_counter_byte_if_changed
description: Copies a global counter into a field of a structure when the two differ, and sets that structure's flag in the same step.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F07E
name: clear_counter_globals_and_fields
description: Calls a routine, then zeroes four counters and clears a byte field in each of two structures.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F0BE
name: clamp_counters_and_decay_totals
description: Clamps two counters to a maximum of four, copying each into a byte field of a structure when it changed, and decreases two totals by two with a floor at zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F128
name: reset_tracking_flags_and_fields
description: Calls a routine, clears three counters, sets two flags to one, and sets four structure byte fields to zero or three.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F188
name: advance_cycle_byte_when_armed
description: When two flags are both set, advances a cyclic byte field of a structure modulo four, and clears a flag when that byte wraps to zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F1C6
name: advance_second_cycle_byte
description: Advances a cyclic byte field modulo four when two flags are set. While a countdown is running it writes a value from a lookup table into two structure fields and steps the countdown.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F212
name: step_countdown_write_table_value
description: Decrements a countdown, stores it in a global, and writes a table value and a flag into two fields of structures referenced by a pointer. It returns the updated register value.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F258
name: reset_pair_state_check_bit
description: Calls a routine and clears six list-state globals. When a count is below ten it zeroes two structure bytes; otherwise it sets one byte from a bit of a routine's result and sets the other to whether that byte equals four.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F2EA
name: step_state_byte_publish_values
description: When a counter is zero, steps one state byte toward zero or four according to a second byte, and otherwise counts the counter down. It then publishes both state bytes to two globals.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F354
name: clear_flag_bytes_and_counters
description: Calls a routine, clears two flags, and clears a byte field in each of two structures.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F388
name: increment_flagged_cycle_bytes
description: For each of two flags that is set, increments a cyclic byte field of its structure, wrapping to zero when it reaches three and clearing the flag at that wrap.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:F3E6
name: initialize_graphics_handles_and_flags
description: Makes four calls to a routine with a global pointer and zero, storing each result in a global, and its text references are the pnt_back, pnt_drop, pnt_plne and shower graphics. It then resets several counters and flags, clears a byte field in each entry of a pointer list until a terminator, and when the count exceeds one loops six times through a second routine.
